title: Weeping Shadow and Mouse
description: A surreal painting shows a tall, black, featureless humanoid figure with large tear-filled eyes and golden tears streaming down, standing in a cracked desert landscape under a full moon. In a circular hole in the ground, a second identical black head emerges, also crying, surrounded by purple flowers and vines, while a small red mouse stands nearby looking up.
prompt: Surreal painting of a tall black humanoid figure with enormous glossy eyes and golden tears dripping down, standing in a cracked desert under a detailed full moon in a blue night sky. A second identical black head is emerging from a circular hole in the ground, also crying golden tears, framed by purple flowers and vines. A small bright red mouse stands on the sand looking up at the figure. Cracked earth with footprints visible, dark dripping paint effects at the top, emotional and melancholic atmosphere.
